name: Inflection GRO Decomposition (AUA Growth = NNA + Return + ε)
description: Replace 'GRO = AUA delta %' (contaminated by NNA flows) with a structurally-decomposed product: AUA_growth_$ = NNA_$ + return_$ + epsilon_$. Three first-class fields surfaced to partner-facing portal so partners can read 'how much bigger is the book' (AUA delta) AND 'how well did the advisor invest' (TWR%) AND 'what residual accounting noise is leaking' (ε). Canonical architecture: single Orion-cashflow taxonomy YAML consumed by BOTH NNA computation (existing INF_C_01) AND new TWR-derived return computation (Stage 1 silver build). One reconciliation table at platinum-tier exposes ε per (entity, period). Architectural invariant: AUA_growth = NNA + Return + ε, with ε MEASURED-not-assumed (CVO ruling: two-stage tolerance — Phase A surface ε empirically, Phase B ratchet tolerance once derivation method proven).

source_brief: Research-agent foundational survey 2026-05-11 ~20:30Z + Andrew direct on GRO product intent ('parse out how much AUA delta is from NNA and how much is from market performance — without misinterpreting accounting cashflows or residual activity as economic NNA or true market growth') + CVO architectural review with 3 sharpenings (TWR%≠return_$ direct conversion; tolerance measured-not-assumed; Q4 escalate-not-fallback).
phase:
CANCELLED 2026-05-23 (Andrew-directed surgical rollback). Portal-side TOs .005 + .006 were architecturally misaligned: both targeted the shared `portal/src/pages/AdvisorIntelligence/_shared/tabs/AdvisorsTab.tsx` on the assumption that Inflection partners navigate to an Advisors tab. They do not — Inflection's user-visible UX is **Distribution + Books only** (AdvisorsTab is a 49F-only surface in the live nav, and `_partners/inflection/index.tsx` line 247-250 explicitly notes 'the partner has no per-advisor data decomposition; all populations browse the firm view'). DE 0.4 INFGRO.005 ship `abe33b0c` (Return per-advisor column gated on `advisor_return_pct_twr !== undefined`) was dead code on both surfaces — the field is Inflection-only, so the gate hides the column on 49F while Inflection users never navigate to the rendering surface. Reverted by CTO `5cee8276` on portal DEV 2026-05-23.

WHAT SHIPPED + RETAINED (data layer, production-live): Stage 0 cashflow taxonomy YAML (TO-000/000b, DS~C, 2026-05-11, `119b04124` + `ece8e184b`); Stage 1 backend .001-.004 (`45e72f5e7` INF_C_03 perf-canonical silver / `f39550d99` puller summaries-block / `252c6c608` INF_C_02 TWR decomposition / `6b94d8a8a` INF_D_00c leaderboard GRO rollup); .007 window-TWR Axis-2 chain-link fix (DS~C `2952a1bee`, 2026-05-18); .008 Finding B diagnosis (DS~C `9643a151a`, 2026-05-18); .009 INF_C_02 TWR-factor rebuild (DS~C, 2026-05-18, materialized post-chain). leaderboard.json continues to emit per-advisor `advisor_return_pct_twr`, `advisor_nna_$`, and `advisor_epsilon_$` fields. If a future project re-targets the GRO decomposition to an Inflection-appropriate surface (most likely `InflectionInsightsPanel` inside the Books tab, or a new firm-centric decomposition view), the data layer is already in production. The work is not lost.

WHAT WAS CANCELLED: portal-side TOs .005 (GRO side-by-side in AdvisorsTab) + .006 (MAX-window TWR re-enable on AdvisorsTab). Both TO files updated to `<status>cancelled</status>` with reason annotation 2026-05-23.

CTO RETROSPECTIVE: the 2026-05-11 TO authorship treated Inflection as a 49F-shape partner (multiple advisors → AdvisorsTab) without verifying Inflection's actual tab nav. The data layer assumption was right (4 Inflection advisors); the UX surface assumption was wrong (firm-centric, not advisor-decomposed). The compiler-tools mandate now requires `comp-transform schema-check` against the actual component before PRD authorship — would have caught this in 2026-05-11 if applied. The D-001 PHASE 2 META success signal (`holistic-purpose meta-analysis`) we landed in DIRECTIVES.md v1.4 `5e306b09c` is designed to surface this exact class of error — a mechanically-functional output (the column rendered fine) failing the holistic-purpose test (no partner sees it).
